cached_binaries.role: VIPLite 2 hardware-abstraction library: opens /dev/vipcore, wraps the single driver ioctl, keeps a copy of the four-row feature database, user-space heap, and three command/descriptor generators (NN transpose descriptor, transpose load-states, multi-core semaphore sync).
cached_binaries.label: observed
notes: Command size table: 30 u32 at file offset 0x7358; command-name table: 30 x 48-byte strings at 0x73e8.
Feature database copy: 4 rows x 36 bytes at file offset 0x91b0 (.data, vaddr 0x191b0); viphal_init selects the row whose pid equals hw_cid from QUERY_DATABASE (loop 0x37d0-0x37f4).
No embedded firmware: dense non-text regions are .text and .eh_frame only.

cached_binaries.role: VIPLite 2 network loader (public vip_* API): parses NBG fixed-header and directory formats, verifies CRC, allocates device memory through libVIPhal, relocates descriptors, builds the command buffer prefix and tail, registers tasks and submits through libVIPhal.
cached_binaries.label: observed
notes: Calls the kernel only through libVIPhal; imports viphal_read_reg (identity reads 0x20/0x24/0x28/0x30 for the capture header at 0x1d644-0x1d680 and 0x1d890-0x1d8cc) but not viphal_write_reg or viphal_power_management.
vip_power_management (0xf9c0) is a stub returning VIP_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED (-4) with the message at 0x21270 (built without vpmdENABLE_USER_CONTROL_POWER).
No embedded firmware; the only non-string rodata table is 104 bytes at 0x1fd48.
